data.content_ref: inline:07c3398912d4 integrates SRC_006's carriage closure with SRC_011's inner/outer split: before the inner warrant labelling, materialize every attacker-of-validity_node as an attacker of the carriage edge, so the outer attack relation is fully determined by accepted warrants. Refuted if an attacker accepted only in the outer pass is needed to make a carriage edge survive, because then integration requires a mutual recursion the two-pass design forbids.
